question:
The English alphabetical series written in reverse order is given.

Which letter will be 18th to the right of the letter that is 24th from the right end?
solution:
According to the given information:

The English alphabetical series written in reverse order is given.

The reverse of the English alphabet starts with Z and ends with A.

Z Y X W V U T S R Q P O N M L K J I H G F E D C B A

24th letter from the right end = X

Z Y **X** W V U T S R Q P O N M L K J I H G F E D
